marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech & AI Integration
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed tech giants reported a 25% year-over-year increase in enterprise cloud and AI service revenues during recent earnings disclosures.
marketLayer.inference: Monetization of commercial generative AI tools is accelerating, providing a structural re-rating catalyst for Hang Seng Tech Index constituents.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Cross-border data compliance rules and the sustainability of foreign capital inflows into HK equities.

marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Leading US mega-cap semiconductor producers elevated full-year CapEx guidance following sustained demand signals from global hyperscalers.
marketLayer.inference: High capital spending in AI hardware continues to provide robust revenue visibility for upstream chip designers and equipment manufacturers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Advanced packaging supply chain bottlenecks and potential shifts in international tech export policies.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Monetary Conditions & High-Yield Assets
marketLayer.fact: The HKMA kept the Base Rate steady in lockstep with the US Fed, while short-term HIBOR rates showed marginal easing across 1-month and 3-month tenors.
marketLayer.inference: Easing liquidity pressures reduce debt servicing burdens for local enterprises and enhance the relative attractiveness of high-dividend yield HK equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Timing and magnitude of future US Fed interest rate adjustments affecting the USD/HKD peg dynamics.
